name: rejoinbi
description: Operate Rejoin BI workspaces, uploads, pages, BI Studio, Data Engine, and safely scoped platform administration from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Develop, publish, and safely operate Rejoin BI
interface.longDescription: Helps Codex connect to a full Rejoin BI address, list workspaces, validate protected workspaces, upload app files, publish BI/ECharts projects, inventory BI Studio and Data Engine resources, manage persistent databases, inspect and migrate project SQLite databases with schema/data validation, and operate pages, branding, messaging, AI, system tools, and upload diagnostics through the authenticated API. User records, direct permissions, and permission groups are isolated from ordinary work: they are inaccessible unless the request explicitly concerns that exact area and the matching scope and confirmation flags are supplied. Natural-language requests to create, manage, back up, query, tokenize, or migrate a database are routed to dedicated managed-databases workflows. Before any other platform action, validate a full address such as subdomain.rejoinbi.com.br and confirm authentication/permission.
